annotation.title_clean: Wearable Four Degree of Freedom Upper-Limb Soft Robotic Rehabilitation Device; Disney Doesn't Care: Analyzing Ethical Failures in the AI Replication of James Earl Jones's Voice Through Care Ethics
annotation.title_en: Wearable Four Degree of Freedom Upper-Limb Soft Robotic Rehabilitation Device; Disney Doesn't Care: Analyzing Ethical Failures in the AI Replication of James Earl Jones's Voice Through Care Ethics
annotation.venue: University of Virginia Libra Online Archive (School of Engineering and Applied Science, BS thesis)
annotation.summary_en: Undergraduate engineering thesis record combining a technical project on a wearable soft robotic upper-limb exoskeleton for stroke rehabilitation with an STS paper applying care ethics to Disney's AI replica of James Earl Jones's voice in Fortnite. Argues companies and engineers owe users attentiveness and accountability.
key_provisions_or_claims: Care ethics lens applied to Disney's AI Darth Vader voice in Fortnite
Argues Disney showed lack of care toward SAG-AFTRA, the actor's voice and young consumers
Technical project: four-DoF soft robotic exoskeleton for at-home stroke rehabilitation
Engineers should design with users in mind and proactively raise safety concerns
